_comment: The character set the ko subset pair carries (plan T-419 decision 8, the Traditional pair retired with its catalog by plan T-537, the zh-Hans and ja pairs dropped for the OS system-font fallback by plan T-538's owner-ruled C3): the subset is cut with fontTools over the closed string set - every character of the ko catalog, its native-strings.json row, its widget-statics.json row, its endonym, and the What's New keys that resolve through the catalog - and this lock is generated from the subset's own cmap, so shared/__tests__/cjkSubset.test.ts names any byte the subset misses or the strings drop. files binds the committed binaries by sha256 so a re-cut shipping stale TTFs cannot pass the gate. Regenerate from the repo root with the full statics fetched OUTSIDE the repository (decision 8): node scripts/cjk-subset.mjs <dir>.
